Since closing Fund V in 2023, Argonaut has fully deployed that fund's capital across a diversified group of platform businesses and has completed several successful exits, including American Well Services, Crimson Steel Supply and VoidForm Products.

APE VI is backed by leading institutional investors, including insurance companies, pension funds, endowments, foundations, family offices and sovereign wealth funds.

"We are grateful to our investors, both longstanding partners and those joining us for the first time, for their belief in and support of our differentiated strategy. Interest in APE VI was quite strong, allowing us to exceed our target while remaining disciplined in our sourcing and underwriting of new opportunities," said Steve Mitchell, CEO and Managing Director of Argonaut. "Throughout our history, we have stuck to our knitting of investing in great industrial businesses at reasonable prices, using minimal leverage, and implementing thoughtful growth strategies. That approach will persist through APE VI and beyond."

Since its founding in 2002, Argonaut has deployed over $2.5 billion across more than 50 platform companies, consistently creating value through hands-on operational improvements regardless of the interest rate environment. These include implementing lean manufacturing processes, upgrading technology and reporting systems, strengthening management teams, and pursuing add-on acquisitions.

"As competition for great businesses in private equity's middle market gets more competitive each year, Argonaut continues to be a partner of choice for founder- and family-owned businesses in Middle America," said Kelby Hagar, President and Managing Director of Argonaut. "APE VI will remain focused on the sectors and regions we know best, and where our presence and relationships continue to give us a competitive advantage."

Founded in 2002, Argonaut Private Equity is a Tulsa, OK-based private equity firm with $3 billion of assets under management. Argonaut partners with companies to develop a strategy for accelerating growth and enhancing operations. For more information, please visit www.argonautpe.com.
